description: Every control of the macOS menu, settings window, profile editor, log and About window, with the helper command the Windows and Linux shells send for it (or shell for presentation only, part_of for a confirmation button, cancel for a control that cancels a running command of its workflow and otherwise sends a command), when macOS offers and enables it, and the Windows and Linux control. Checked by scripts/check-macos-parity.mjs and by the helper and shell tests (AC-29 in docs/specs/cross-platform-client.spec.md).

rule_syntax: offered_when and enabled_when read the helper details event and the shell context (selected, selected.attached, selected.pending, item.* for a per-item control). Alternatives are separated by " or ", clauses by " & "; a clause is key (true: non-empty and not "false"), !key, key=a|b, key!=a|b, or key>N and key=N for numbers. Empty means always.
